Smoke test: load sparql and parse a simple snippet

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s ?p ?o }", config: configObj)
print(result)
```
